notes.title: 🛠️ Mini Update Notes – HotFix 🛠️
notes.content:
🎉 Power System Activated! 🎉
Our long-awaited Power System is now live! The power of your heroes will now be influenced by various factors, from gems embedded in items to buff-granting foods. You can track your hero's power level directly from the menu screen!

⚙️ Bug Fixes & Improvements:

🛡️ Fixed the issue where special passives wouldn't activate upon reaching 100 TP.
🗺️ Minor bugs fixed in the Orc Valley area.
💎 Corrected typos on + enhancement gems.
📦 Adjusted the rarity levels of certain items.
❄️ Winter-themed snow effects and music updates added.
⛏️ Coal veins now appear more frequently in the Orc Valley!
⚡ Empower your adventure and keep exploring the world of Elixir of Life! ⚡

notes.content:
Minor improvements and bug fixes.
You can now repair elevators directly from the mine entrance! No need to descend to the elevator's floor.
Fixed an issue where passive stats were not working as intended.
Resolved some issues in the Hunter Guild.
Fixed a bug where gifting weapons and armor vendors caused errors.
Coal veins will now appear more frequently as you delve deeper into the mine.
Added more bushes to the swamp area.
Various text and visual adjustments have been made.

notes.title: ❄️ Elixir of Life 1.9.5 – Winter Fortress Awaits! ❄️
notes.content:
🎉 Winter Fortress Event Has Begun! ❄️

The legendary Winter Fortress opens its gates with chilling winds in this update! Brave 15 challenging floors, explore frosty corridors, and discover unique equipment, potions, and rare gems that can only be obtained from this event!

⚔️ Perilous Floors Await:
Face powerful bosses on floors 5, 10, and 15!
Each floor cleared grants exclusive rewards obtainable only in this event.
A grand completion reward awaits those who conquer the final floor!

The event will be active for at least 3 months!
It will return every New Year with expanded content and greater challenges.
Plenty of time to reach the top and claim your rewards!

🆕 Content & Enemies:
12+ new monsters!
3 powerful new bosses!
3 unique pieces of equipment obtainable only from this event (non-craftable).

🎮 Gameplay Progression & Balancing:
Max level increased from 70 to 80!
A new difficulty level added to the Void Portal: Medium (Lv. 50-99).
In the next update, expect a Hard Mode (Lv. 75-99) with even more maps and new threats!
New Epic & Legendary gear!

⚖️ Balancing Adjustments:
Several monsters and drop rates adjusted.
Silver Ingot crafting cost reduced from 4 ore → 3 ore.
EXP gain from bosses and monsters increased.
Gold drop rates from bosses and monsters increased.

🛠️ Bug Fixes & Improvements:
Storage chest bugs fixed.
Item categorization issues resolved.
Multiple typos corrected.
Min-Max monster levels adjusted.

🍀 Additional Changes:
EXP Potion Added: Balances under-leveled characters.
3 new pieces of equipment!
5 new potions obtainable only through drops!
⚔️ A legendary adventure awaits you in the Winter Fortress! Prepare yourself, for the frozen depths hide dangers and treasures yet to be uncovered! 🌨️

notes.title: Patch V 1.9.0
notes.content:
Hello Friends,

We are excited to announce that after a long period of hard work, our major update is finally here! With a plethora of new features and content, this update aims to provide you with an even more enjoyable gaming experience. Here are some key enhancements that come with this update:

[h1]New Features:[/h1]

[b]Void Portal:[/b] You will now come across the Void Portal next to the Hunter Guild in the Forest Town map. Through this mysterious portal, you'll be able to teleport to the Void Realm, embarking on a new adventure where unique rare and legendary items await. However, bear in mind that the Void Realm is filled with challenging trials. In the Void maps, you can discover valuable resources such as chests, hollow stones, and mineral veins. But be cautious, the curse of the Void will accompany you with each step, growing stronger as you shatter hollow stones. As you approach a boss, the curses will intensify; however, completing a task or defeating a boss will lift the curses.

[b]Hunter Quest:[/b] The Hunter Guild is now the stage for a rivalry between the blue and red teams. Regardless of the team you choose, you can select tasks worth 1, 2, or 3 points. By completing these tasks, you'll contribute points to your team. Throughout the 7-day Hunter Races, you can take on as many tasks as you wish each day. At the end of the competition, you'll have the chance to win two different rewards, regardless of whether your team wins. Moreover, based on your personal points, you can earn additional rewards.

[b]Automated Mining:[/b] Four automated digging machines await you at the mine entrance. By repairing and upgrading these machines, you can automatically collect ores from the mine. You'll have options for continuous mining for 1, 2, or 3 days. As you level up, you can reach deeper levels and excavate new minerals. Mining now comes with an additional helper!

[b]Auto Save:[/b] The game will now automatically save to your last save slot every day. This ensures that even if you forget to save, your losses will be minimized!

[b]Auto Fight:[/b] In battles, you can now switch between automatic and manual combat modes. After using your potions and updating your equipment, you can lean back and watch the battle unfold or take control to target specific enemies.

[b]Time Flow:[/b] Days now pass more slowly in the game. The length of a day has been increased by 20%, allowing you more time to engage in various activities.

[b]Passive Stats:[/b] Each character now has the opportunity to improve up to 20 different stats. By crafting necessary items, you can grant permanent stat boosts to your characters.

[b]Friendship Rewards:[/b] Vendors will now give you rewards based on your friendship level with them.

In-Game Enhancements and Expansions:

[list]
[*] Level cap is now 70!
[*] The stack limit for wood, stone, coal, sand, and ores is 300.
[*] Coal veins have been added to the mine and Void maps.
[*] The mine has been expanded by 5 new levels, and level 70 equipment has been introduced.
[*] Two new bosses and creatures have been added to the game world.
[*] An elevator to reach the 15th floor and more mining content.
[*] New items such as diamonds, emeralds, and animal feed.
[*] Over 30 new pieces of equipment, some of which can only be obtained through special drops.
[*] Intensive work has been done on balancing, bug fixes, and correcting typos.
[*] Regular balancing and improvements will continue throughout 2024.
[/list]

[b]Special Note:[/b]
Lastly, we would like to share news from the creative team behind the game. Unfortunately, the creator of the game, FurkanHan, will be away from the game for the next 6 months due to mandatory military service. However, upon returning in early 2024, they will resume working on the development of the full version.

Enjoy the game with this update, revel in a flawless and enriched gaming experience. We'll be awaiting your return in 2024! Wishing everyone happy gaming.
